### Mastercard Incorporated Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Available on Company’s Website


October 29, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/479285134/files/content_files/3Q26-Mastercard-Earnings-Release.pdf)


PURCHASE, N.Y.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE: MA) today announced its third quarter 2026 financial results through an earnings release available on the company’s Investor Relations website at[investor.mastercard.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.mastercard.com%2Finvestor-relations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54630975&newsitemid=20261028040121&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.mastercard.com&index=1&md5=41c4c640c6cefa7a17a87a49675e7aed) . The earnings release will be furnished with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on a Form 8-K and available[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov%2Fcgi-bin%2Fbrowse-edgar%3FCIK%3DMA%26action%3Dgetcompany%26owner%3Dexclude&esheet=54630975&newsitemid=20261028040121&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=2&md5=64fae50ad98c95dbffccb309d061d531) .


At 9:00 a.m. ET today, the company will host a conference call to discuss these financial results.
